headline: Indian Markets Face Mixed Signals Amid Record FII Inflows and Global Crash Fears

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Record FII buying has extended Indian market's rally to 4-week highs.
Fears of a Black Monday crash grip global markets following AI selloffs.
Strong equity inflows are expected to bolster the Rupee towards 91.50/$.
Markets previously demonstrated strength by jumping 898 points despite global routs.
whatHappening: APL Apollo Tubes moved above its volume-weighted average price (VWAP).
HDFC Bank exhibited a bullish White Marubozu technical chart pattern.
PL Capital retained a 'Reduce' rating on Tata Technologies citing limited upside.
Sensex and Nifty eye opening trends amidst contrasting domestic and global cues.
summary: Indian stock markets are weighing strong domestic sentiment driven by record FII buying against global market crash fears. Key individual stocks like HDFC Bank and APL Apollo Tubes show bullish technical indicators. Meanwhile, Tata Technologies faces headwinds following a analyst downgrade.
